target.outcome: County ischemic stroke mortality rate among adults aged 65+ (ICD-10 I63, I65-I66)
target.geography: US counties and county equivalents, excluding territories stated by article
target.effect_scale: native OLS change in deaths per 100,000 per 1 ug/m3 PM2.5

substitutions.reanalysis: EPA AQS annual PM2.5 monitor arithmetic means aggregated to county
substitutions.reason: independent public source required; monitor coverage is incomplete and only 2016/2020 retrieved before stop

coverage.notes: No complete merged panel. EPA AQS monitor data were available locally for 2016 and 2020 only; no outcome table or locked covariate table was obtained.

blockers: CDC WONDER automated county outcome query did not produce a data table after accepted request form; response evidence retained.
Independent EPA AQS PM2.5 monitor data are not complete county coverage and only 2016 and 2020 were successfully retrieved locally.
The article-specified covariates (CAD, HTN, HLD, DM, obesity, smoking, income, Gini, poverty, uninsured, park access) were not reconstructed; fitting would require invented/relaxed panel coverage.

fidelity_record.locked_target: county-level age-65+ ischemic-stroke mortality rate, US counties, 2016-2020; PM2.5
